sites.rationale: exposed, 3D-clear insertion point within a low-pLDDT disordered extracellular run (>=4 aa)

sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)

literature_notes: All six ledger lines were evaluated. L1 and L2 (PMC9805020) describe a FLAG-tagged claudin-3ΔYVF construct in which the C-terminal YV (Y219, V220) are deleted and a FLAG tag is appended; the C-terminus of claudin-3 is intracellular (residues 181–220), so this is an intracellular tag, not a surface site. L4 and L5 (PMC11490706) describe 'FLAG-Cldn3', where the hyphenated prefix naming convention places FLAG at the N-terminus; the N-terminus of claudin-3 is also intracellular (residues 1–8), so again not a surface site. L3 (PMC13004409) describes 'CLDN3-Myc', where the suffix naming convention places Myc at the C-terminus (intracellular). L6 (PMC11490706) describes a SNAP-tagged human Cldn3 that forms TJ-like meshworks in COS-7 cells, but the ledger line names no residue and no loop — it is impossible to determine whether the SNAP tag is at the N-terminus, C-terminus, or in a loop, and neither terminus of claudin-3 is extracellular. Because no ledger line grounds a tag at an extracellular position with a pinnable residue or even a named extracellular loop, zero sites qualify. The two extracellular loops (ECL1, residues 30–80; ECL2, residues 137–159) are structurally plausible targets but no ledger evidence supports an insertion there.
